review.notes: Machine-drafted by an AI model; awaiting native-speaker review. House style: moderate Bokmål with three genders (ei/-a for feminine nouns, en/-en masculine, et/-et neuter), weak past in -et, neuter definite plural in -ene, sju and tjue, "ble", "ga". First-person past tense with subordinate clauses introduced by "før" and "da". "Husker du da du kom?" begins a short dialogue.

sentences.text: Før jeg kom til Norge, bodde jeg i USA. Jeg hadde ei mor, en far og en bror.
sentences.english: Before I came to Norway I lived in the USA. I had a mother, a father and a brother.

sentences.text: Jeg ville bo i Norge i et år. Derfor pakket jeg ei veske.
sentences.english: I wanted to live in Norway for a year. That is why I packed a bag.

sentences.text: I vesken hadde jeg jakka mi, to bøker og bibelen min. Jeg pakket ikke mye.
sentences.english: In the bag I had my jacket, two books and my Bible. I did not pack much.

sentences.text: Mora mi sa: «Du må ringe oss!» Jeg sa: «Ja, jeg skal ringe hver søndag.»
sentences.english: My mother said: "You must call us!" I said: "Yes, I will call every Sunday."

sentences.text: Vennene mine i USA sa: «Du skal reise til Norge? Det er langt!»
sentences.english: My friends in the USA said: "You are going to travel to Norway? That is far!"

sentences.text: Jeg sa: «Ja, derfor må jeg pakke nå.»
sentences.english: I said: "Yes, that is why I have to pack now."

sentences.text: Jeg tok flyet til Norge. Reisen var lang. Jeg sov lenge i flyet.
sentences.english: I took the plane to Norway. The journey was long. I slept for a long time on the plane.

sentences.text: Flyet kom til Bergen klokka fem. Etter reisen var jeg trøtt, men jeg var glad.
sentences.english: The plane arrived in Bergen at five o'clock. After the journey I was tired, but I was happy.

sentences.text: Jeg ventet på Anna. Hun skulle treffe meg. Jeg ventet lenge.
sentences.english: I waited for Anna. She was going to meet me. I waited a long time.

sentences.text: Så kom Anna. Hun sa: «Hei, Sam! Her er jeg!» Jeg sa: «Det går bra.»
sentences.english: Then Anna came. She said: "Hi, Sam! Here I am!" I said: "That is fine."

sentences.text: Da jeg kom til huset, var Lars hjemme. Han drakk kaffe.
sentences.english: When I came to the house, Lars was at home. He was drinking coffee.

sentences.text: Byen var ny, og maten var ny. Det var en ny dag, og jeg var i Norge.
sentences.english: The town was new, and the food was new. It was a new day, and I was in Norway.

sentences.text: Jeg hadde ikke mange venner i Norge. Nå har jeg Anna, Lars, Marta og Nils. De er venner.
sentences.english: I did not have many friends in Norway. Now I have Anna, Lars, Marta and Nils. They are friends.

sentences.text: Husker du da du kom til Bergen, Sam?
sentences.english: Do you remember when you came to Bergen, Sam?
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Ja! Det regnet, og jeg hadde ikke paraply. Jeg var våt.
sentences.english: Yes! It was raining, and I had no umbrella. I was wet.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Du var trøtt, og du snakket litt. Men du snakket norsk!
sentences.english: You were tired, and you spoke a little. But you spoke Norwegian!
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Nei, jeg kunne litt norsk. Derfor ventet jeg lenge på deg.
sentences.english: No, I knew a little Norwegian. That is why I waited for you so long.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Du var snill, og du ventet ikke for lenge.
sentences.english: You were kind, and you did not wait too long.
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Da du kom, drakk vi kaffe.
sentences.english: When you came, we drank coffee.
sentences.speaker: luis

sentences.text: Ja, jeg var glad for kaffen.
sentences.english: Yes, I was glad for the coffee.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Da jeg kom til Norge, ba jeg en bønn. Jeg takket Gud, og jeg hadde håp. Gud tilgir synd.
sentences.english: When I came to Norway, I said a prayer. I thanked God, and I had hope. God forgives sin.

sentences.text: Jeg sendte en melding til Anna. Hun svarte at hun hadde tid. Vi hadde en plan: Vi skulle treffe Lars.
sentences.english: I sent a message to Anna. She answered that she had time. We had a plan: We were going to meet Lars.

sentences.text: Sør i landet er det varmt, men nord i landet er det kaldt.
sentences.english: In the south of the country it is warm, but in the north of the country it is cold.

sentences.text: Marta liker gjester.
sentences.english: Marta likes guests.
